metric_catalogue.label: Methane from the landfill
metric_catalogue.caveat: Calculated by the operator with EPA's method, not measured. EPA publishes it as tonnes of CO2 equivalent.

metric_catalogue.label: Biogenic CO2 from burning fuel on site
metric_catalogue.caveat: CO2 from burning landfill gas is counted here. Filed only by sites that report stationary combustion to EPA.

metric_catalogue.label: Other CO2 from burning fuel on site
metric_catalogue.caveat: CO2 from fuel that EPA does not count as biogenic. Filed only by sites that report stationary combustion to EPA.

metric_catalogue.label: Methane from burning fuel on site
metric_catalogue.caveat: Filed only by sites that report stationary combustion to EPA.

metric_catalogue.label: Nitrous oxide from burning fuel on site
metric_catalogue.caveat: Filed only by sites that report stationary combustion to EPA.

metric_catalogue.label: Days searched for CO2
metric_catalogue.caveat: Days on which a scene that Carbon Mapper searched for CO2 covered the landfill. A year with no figure was not searched.

metric_catalogue.label: CO2 plumes found on or beside the landfill
metric_catalogue.caveat: Plumes that start on the landfill's outline or within 500 m of it, whatever source Carbon Mapper tagged them with. A plume beside a landfill can come from a neighbouring plant. This search picks up only very large CO2 sources, such as power plants, so "none found" does not mean no CO2.

metric_catalogue.label: Waste in place
metric_catalogue.caveat: All the waste buried at the landfill so far, in short tons (2,000 pounds each). EPA does not update this figure every year.

metric_catalogue.label: Year of the waste-in-place figure
metric_catalogue.caveat: Listed only where EPA gives the year.

metric_catalogue.label: Gas collection system in place
metric_catalogue.caveat: "Yes" means a system that actively draws gas out of the landfill. EPA writes "No" where there is no system, where gas only vents or flares passively, or where the only wells are around the edge.

metric_catalogue.unit: million standard cubic feet a day
metric_catalogue.label: Landfill gas collected
metric_catalogue.caveat: All of the gas the system draws out, not methane alone. It is not the amount the landfill makes, and it is not the amount that escapes.

metric_catalogue.unit: million standard cubic feet a day
metric_catalogue.label: Landfill gas flared
metric_catalogue.caveat: Gas burned in flares. Where an energy project is running, EPA lists the gas burned in back-up flares.

metric_catalogue.label: Energy projects running
metric_catalogue.caveat: Projects that turn the landfill's gas into electricity, heat or fuel and that EPA lists as operational. Projects that have shut down or are only planned are not counted.

metric_catalogue.label: Types of energy project running
metric_catalogue.caveat: As EPA names them.

metric_catalogue.label: Census tract the landfill sits in
metric_catalogue.caveat: The tract that holds the largest part of the landfill's outline, by its 2020 Census number.

metric_catalogue.label: People living in that tract
metric_catalogue.caveat: The 2024 five-year census estimate, as the state's file gives it.

metric_catalogue.label: CalEnviroScreen overall percentile of that tract
metric_catalogue.caveat: The state scores every census tract by combining measures of pollution with measures of the people living there. A percentile of 70 means the tract scores higher than about 70% of California's tracts. A higher score means, by the state's method, more pollution burden and a population more vulnerable to it. The score counts solid waste sites near homes, so a landfill can be part of its own tract's score.

metric_catalogue.label: Pollution Burden percentile of that tract
metric_catalogue.caveat: One of the two parts of the overall score: the state's measures of pollution in the tract from every kind of source, such as traffic, industry, pesticides and waste sites.

metric_catalogue.label: Population Characteristics percentile of that tract
metric_catalogue.caveat: The other part of the overall score: the state's measures of the people living in the tract, such as poverty, education and the rates of certain illnesses.

metric_catalogue.label: Census tracts within 1 km of the outline
metric_catalogue.caveat: Every tract with any part within 1 km of the landfill's outline, its own included.

metric_catalogue.label: Lowest overall percentile among those tracts
metric_catalogue.caveat: The lowest and the highest are given as the state publishes them for those tracts. Nothing is averaged across tracts.

metric_catalogue.label: Highest overall percentile among those tracts
